properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TWALA-obulamu bwange
Obufugire ddala,
Ebiro bye ndimala
Bibe bya kukusinza.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Twala-emikono gyange
Okukuweerezanga;
Twala-ebigere byangge
Ntambulirenga mu ggwe.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Twala-eddoboozi lyange
Nkutendereze Yesu;
Twala n'emimwa gyange
Gibuulirenga-Enjiri.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Twala ne bye ndowooza,
Ndowoozenga by'osiima;
Twala-omutima gwange
Bulijjo-ogukuumenga

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Twala bye nnina byonna,
Byonna bibyo si byange;
Twala-amagezi gange
Gakozese by'osiima.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Twala-okwagala kwange,
Ntwala nzenna nga bwe ndi;
Yesu-ontwalire ddala,
-Emirembe ne'mirembe
